blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Perimeter triage faces a latency/semantics trade-off: signature engines are fast and format-safe but blind to unseen attacks, while generative models are semantic but slow and produce unparseable output. In late 2026 a class of commercial System One decision models (TypeSafe Jev; Microsoft-Decision-1) began selling typed decision primitives - binary gates, closed-set choices, ordinal scores - as product APIs, with no academic treatment. We present VX-One: a small multi-head network (100K-10M parameters) whose outputs are these primitives - a calibrated gate, a choice over a closed candidate set that always includes an explicit unknown option, and an ordinal score, trained multi-task, temperature-calibrated per head (~0.7-1.7 ms p50 on CPU). We evaluate it on UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017, EMBER2024 against calibrated XGBoost, Random-Forest, MLP, Kitsune, and measure a two-phase cascade (Suricata with 52,674 Emerging-Threats rules -> VX-One) over five days of CIC-IDS2017. Findings: (i) VX-One wins detection (AUROC/FPR@95%TPR) on UNSW-NB15 and under temporal drift on CIC-IDS2017 (0.711 vs 0.637), but XGBoost wins multi-class attribution on all three benchmarks; (ii) leave-one-family-out gate detects never-seen families on 9/9 UNSW folds yet drops below chance on CIC recon family, and abstention threshold transfers poorly across benchmarks; (iii) on payload-less reconstructions signature engines resolve ~0.1% of flows - gray zone ~99.9% of traffic, recovered by Phase 2 (combined recall >=0.978); (iv) calibration collapses under temporal drift (ECE 0.04->0.40) for every method while ranking partially survives. We provide a measured account of where typed calibrated decisions help perimeter triage, and where they fail.
blocks.zh: 近缘分解面临暂时性/语义取舍:签名引擎快而格式安全但盲从了看不见的攻击;而基因模型是语义性但缓慢并产生无法分解的输出. 2026年后期,一号商业系统决定模型(TypeSafe Jev;Microsoft-Decision-1)作为产品API开始销售被打入了决定的原始-二进制门,封闭式设置选择,平分-作为产品,没有学术待遇. 我们提出VX-One:一个小型多头网络(100K-10M参数),其输出是这些原始的-校正门,选择一个总是包含一个明确未知选项的封闭候选集,以及一个经训练的多任务,温度校正每头(CPU上~0.7-1.7ms p50)的正数分. 我们在UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS2017、EMBER2024上对校准的XGBoost、Random-Forest、MLP、Kitsune进行了评价,并在CIC-IDS2017的五天内测量出两相级联(Suricata有52 674个新兴-危险规则 -- -- > VX-One)。 调查结果:(一) VX-One在UNSW-NB15上(AUROC/FPR@95%TPR)和CIC-IDS2017上(0.711 vs 6.637)在时间漂移下胜出,但XGBoost在所有三个基准上都赢得了多等归属;(二)在UNSW9/9上,离开一个家庭门检测到永远看不到的家庭,但在CIC侦察家庭上却低于机会,在基准上弃权阈值转让差;(三)在无负载重建上,签名引擎解决了流量的~0.1% -- -- 灰色地段~99.9%,由第二阶段恢复(综合召回~0.978);(四)在时间漂移下校准崩溃(欧洲经委会0.04-0.40),同时将部分活下来。 我们提供了一份有分量的叙述,说明打出校正后的决定在哪些方面有助于周边的分辨,哪些方面失败了。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Operating a mitigation policy on the network boundary requires, simultaneously: nanosecond-scale decisions on the line of fire, calibrated confidences that a controller can threshold, and honest behavior on events that training has never seen. Three incumbent technology classes each miss at least one requirement.
blocks.zh: 在网络边界上执行缓解政策需要同时:在火线上进行纳米秒级决定,校准控制者能起起阈值的信心,以及对训练从未见过的事件采取诚实的行为. 现有3个技术班,每个班至少没有达到1个要求。

blocks.en: (1) Deterministic engines (Snort ( Roesch, 1999 ) , Suricata ( Open Information Security Foundation, 2026 ) , Zeek/Bro ( Paxson, 1999 ) , YARA ( VirusTotal, 2026 ) ) are fast and format-safe but structurally blind to zero-day and low-and-slow offensives; the recurring failure mode is a rule explosion that no operations team can maintain. (2) Text LLMs for security (e.g., SecureBERT ( Aghaei et al., 2022 ) )— bidirectional encoders, not autoregressive models , a conflation we correct—bring domain semantics, but as fine-grained decision engines on the line of fire they are heavy, and decoder-style LLM agents add generation latency and output-format fragility that a mitigation controller cannot tolerate. (3) Classical ML for intrusion detection performs well on tabular attribution—XGBoost ( Chen and Guestrin, 2016 ) wins our attribution benchmarks—but treats every event as a membership test, producing confident misattributions on families the model never saw (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: (1) 决定性发动机(Snort(Roesch,1999年)),苏里卡塔 (Open Information Security Foundation, 2026),Zeek/Bro (Paxson, 1999),YARA (VirusTotal, 2026) 快速而格式安全,但结构盲从零日低速出击;再起的故障模式是规则爆炸,没有任何行动团队能够维护. (2) 用于安全的文本LLMS(例如,SecureBERT(Aghaei等,2022年))——双向编码器,而不是自旋模型,我们纠正的一种拼接——编织域语义,但作为火线上精细的编织决策引擎,它们很重,而解码器式的LLM剂会增加生成延迟和输出格式的脆弱性,缓解控制器无法容忍. (3) 用于入侵检测的经典ML在表格归属上表现良好(Chen和Guestrin,2016年),赢得了我们的归属基准——但将每起事件视为会员资格测试,对模型从未见过的家庭产生了自信的错误贡献(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: During October 2026, a commercial class of models positioned exactly at this gap began to ship: System One decision models, sold as APIs that take a structured state plus typed questions and return calibrated option probabilities (TypeSafe’s Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026a ; TypeSafe AI, 2026b ) ; Microsoft-Decision-1 ( Microsoft, 2026 ; Microsoft Learn, 2026 ) ). No peer-reviewed academic literature covers the class, its evaluation is vendor-reported, and no security-domain assessment exists.
blocks.zh: 2026年10月,一门完全定位于这一缺口的商用型号开始起航:System 一个决定模型被作为API出售,它采用结构化状态加打出的问题并返回校准的选项概率(TypeSafe's Jev(TypeSafe AI,2026a;TypeSafe AI,2026b;Microsoft-Decision-1(Microsoft,2026;Microsoft Learning,2026)). 没有经同行审查的学术文献涵盖该类,其评价由供应商报告,不存在安全领域评估。

blocks.en: This paper occupies the gap by building the primitives ourselves rather than remoting into a vendor API. VX-One maps a fixed-size event state to three typed decisions in a single forward pass, then evaluates the whole pipeline—including a real signature engine in front of it—on public data with anti-strawman baselines. The contributions are:
blocks.zh: 本文占据了空白,将原始人自己建设起来,而不是重新作为销售商API. VX-One将一个固定大小的事件状态映射到一个单一前行的3个打出的决定,然后在具有反斯特拉曼基线的公共数据上评价整个管道——包括它前面的一个真正的签名引擎. 这些捐款是:

blocks.en: • A typed decision engine (Section 3 ): shared encoder + three primitive heads— gate (calibrated sigmoid), choice (softmax over a declared closed set that always contains unknown ), score (CORN conditional ordinal regression ( Shi et al., 2023 ) )—with per-head temperature calibration on validation data, trained multi-task with a homoscedastic weighting scheme ( Kendall et al., 2018 ) . • Unknown-attack honesty, measured (Section 5.2 ): leave-one-attack-family-out across 9 UNSW-NB15 and 7 CIC-IDS2017 families, plus 4 months of EMBER2024 family drift, reporting both unseen-family detection (gate AUROC) and attribution honesty (how often the unknown option absorbs what the model should not claim to know). • A measured gray zone (Section 5.4 ): Suricata 7 with 52,674 live Emerging-Threats rules over flow-reconstructed CIC-IDS2017 traffic resolves only ∼ \sim 0.1% of daily flows under payload opacity; the combined cascade recovers it with recall ≥ 0.978 \geq 0.978 , at the cost of a measured precision drop on web-attack days where Phase 1 is entirely blind. • Negative results, measured (Sections 5.1 – 5.5 ): calibration collapses under drift for every method (ECE 0.04 → \to 0.40); class-weight tilts that help weak-label attribution can hurt it on saturated benchmarks; a fixed abstention threshold is not portable across calibrations; dropping the unknown option raises macro-F1 by up to + 11.2 +11.2 points—the honesty/utility trade-off is real and quantifiable.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Microsoft’s announcement ( Microsoft, 2026 ) and documentation ( Microsoft Learn, 2026 ) define the primitive triad (binary gate / closed-set choice / ordinal score) with calibrated option probabilities and single-pass scoring; TypeSafe’s Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026a ; TypeSafe AI, 2026b ) commercialized the framing earlier in 2026. Both are vendor announcements without peer-reviewed evaluation; benchmarks cited (193.6 × \times faster, 444.6 × \times cheaper) are industry claims. Our work is the first academic instantiation and security-domain evaluation of the triad; we use their names only for attribution, define our own formal objects (Section 3 ), and deliberately avoid inheriting vendor terminology as if it were neutral vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 微软的公告(微软,2026年)和文档(Microsoft Learn,2026年)定义了原始三相(二相门/闭合设置选择/正数分),并有校正选项概率和单通分;TypeSafe's Jev(TypeSafe AI,2026a;TypeSafe AI,2026b)于2026年早些时候将设定商业化. 两者都是未经同行评审的供应商公告;引用的基准(193.6分x相较快,444.6分x相较便宜)是行业索赔。 我们的工作是对三合会的首次学术即时和安全领域评价;我们只用他们的名字作为归属,定义我们自己的正式对象(第3节),并故意避免继承卖主名词,仿佛它是中性的词汇.

blocks.en: “Non-autoregressive” originates in neural machine translation ( Gu et al., 2018 ) : full output in one forward pass, no decoding loop. We use the term strictly for architecture (shared trunk, parallel typed heads). We do not claim novelty from single-pass-ness—BERT-family classifiers are also single-pass—and our baselines include appropriate encoders; the differentiator is typed calibrated outputs, not one-pass-ness alone. Fast early-exit decision layers for per-event actions predate this design in spirit—the Viola–Jones cascade ( Viola and Jones, 2001 ) is their ancestor.
blocks.zh: “非自动回转”起源于神经机译(Gu等,2018年):一个前传中完全输出,没有解码回路. 我们严格地用这个术语来形容建筑(共享干线,平行打出的头). 我们并不认为单行道-BERT-家族分类器也是单行道-而我们的基线包括适当的编码器;不同的编码器是按校正的输出,而不是单行道。 从精神上讲,每起事件的快速提前退出决策层——Viola-Jones级联(Viola和Jones,2001年)是他们的祖先。

blocks.en: Platt scaling ( Platt, 1999 ) , multiclass probability transforms ( Zadrozny and Elkan, 2002 ) , empirical per-family calibration gaps ( Niculescu-Mizil and Caruana, 2005 ) , and temperature scaling ( Guo et al., 2017 ) define our post-hoc protocol; conformal prediction ( Vovk et al., 2005 ; Angelopoulos and Bates, 2021 ) is an optional wrapper we defer as a guarantee, but audit empirically on the temporal split (Appendix A ), noting that distribution-free coverage claims need exchangeability that temporal splits violate ( Barber et al., 2023 ) . Chow’s reject option ( Chow, 1970 ) and selective classification ( Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ) ground our abstention semantics: with symmetric rejection cost the Bayes-optimal threshold is 1 − λ r = 0.5 1-\lambda_{r}=0.5 , which is the threshold we initially set, and we measure how poorly it transfers where the model is overconfident (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: Platt缩放(Platt,1999年),多类概率变换(Zadrozny和Elkan,2002年),经验性的每个家庭校准差距(Niculescu-Mizil和Caruana,2005年),温度缩放(Guo等,2017年),确定了我们的后热协议;一致性预测(Vovk等,2005年;Angelopoulos和Bates,2021年)是我们作为保证而推迟的可选包装,但对时间分解(Appendix A)进行实证审计,指出无分配覆盖要求时间分解违反可交换性(Barber等,2023年)。 Chow的拒绝选项(Chow,1970年)和选择性分类(Geifman和El-Yaniv,2017年)使我们的弃权语义成立:用对称的拒绝代价,Bayes-opperal 阈值为 1 — — — r = 0.5 1 — — lambda-r-0.5,这是我们最初设定的阈值,我们测量了该模型在过度自信的地方的转移情况(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: Snort ( Roesch, 1999 ) , Zeek ( Paxson, 1999 ) , YARA ( VirusTotal, 2026 ) , and Suricata ( Open Information Security Foundation, 2026 ) anchor the deterministic tier. The DARPA-critique tradition ( McHugh, 2000 ; Mahoney and Chan, 2003 ) set the standard for dataset skepticism; audits of CICIDS2017 ( Engelen et al., 2021 ; Lanvin et al., 2022 ) document systematic labeling errors. We use both stratified and temporal splits and audit against the corrected labels.

blocks.en: Kitsune ( Mirsky et al., 2018 ) is the canonical packet-level unsupervised ensemble; we adapt it to flows (documented) and report its Platt-calibrated but weakly discriminative AUROC ( ≈ \approx 0.61) as a concrete instance of “calibration creates no signal”. Boosted trees ( Chen and Guestrin, 2016 ) are the attribution baseline our engine loses to on all three benchmarks—we calibrate them with the same protocol to make the comparison non-strawman. EMBER2018 ( Anderson and Roth, 2018 ) and EMBER2024 ( Joyce et al., 2025 ) , UNSW-NB15 ( Moustafa and Slay, 2015 ) , and CIC-IDS2017 ( Sharafaldin et al., 2018 ) supply the data tiers. Viola–Jones ( Viola and Jones, 2001 ) is the ancestor of our second-phase-only-when-needed cascade.

blocks.en: 3.1. State object

blocks.en: For single-head functionals, post-processing (de-tilt, temperature, thresholding) keeps the calibration error within a bound determined by the head’s own deficiency (Appendix A , Lemma 1). Across heads, no useful composition bound exists : two perfectly-calibrated heads can combine into a joint policy whose calibration error is 1 / 4 1/4 in the worst case, whatever the marginal ECEs say (Appendix A , Prop. 4)—and the A = B A{=}B case that attains it (two heads estimating the same underlying question) is the realistic one in security. The controller therefore composes boolean decisions between gates and never probabilities between heads; any future composed gate must be rubric-reducible to a single head, or measure its own joint calibration.
blocks.zh: 对于单头功能,后处理(去平,温度,阈值)将校正误差保留在由头部自身缺陷所决定的束缚内(附录A.,Lemma 1). 不论边际的欧洲经委会(附录A,project. 4)如何, 达到这一目的的B案(两个头估计同一基本问题)是安全方面的现实问题。 因此,控制器在闸口之间作出布尔的决定,在头口之间永远不出现概率;任何未来由编成的闸门都必须被划为一头,或者测量自己的联合校正.

blocks.en: (i) VX-One wins detection, not attribution. On UNSW-NB15 and temporal CIC, VX-One tops AUROC and FPR@95%TPR. On CIC by-day every method’s achievable FPR@95 is degraded, but the trees’ degradation is total (FPR@95 = 1.0 — no threshold reaches 95% TPR at nontrivial FPR), while VX-One retains a partially usable operating point. Attribution (macro-F1) inverts this: calibrated XGBoost wins on UNSW, stratified CIC, and EMBER2024—by 4–8 points. We report the inversion rather than hide it : our contribution does not rest on attribution wins, and we are explicit about the loss.

blocks.en: (iii) Kitsune: calibration does not equal signal. With Platt calibration on validation, Kitsune is well-calibrated (ECE 0.037) yet near-chance on discrimination (AUROC 0.608). Its ensemble-of-autoencoders signal does not survive hostile-stage re-fit to benign-only data—we re-fit its feature stage to its own training distribution (benign only), as a real unsupervised deployment would. Platt on a useless score calibrates a useless probability.

blocks.en: Calibration (E3): all methods’ in-distribution ECE stays ≤ \leq 0.065 on UNSW-NB15 but drift to 0.39–0.45 on temporal CIC (Table 1 ). The policy-level implication is precise: ‘Noul/gate feedbacks are calibrated’ (Noul is the vendor’s name for the gate-head calibration loss; we call it the gate, Section 3 ) is a claim about the training distribution; it silently degrades exactly when novel-attack pressure appears, which is the moment the claim was bought for. Section 5.5 shows the effect is additive on top of , not independent of, class-tilt choices. Classwise calibration of Choice (val) stays ≤ \leq 0.007 on all four main runs, and the recon coordinate that feeds g recon g_{\mathrm{recon}} is calibrated at 0.003 (UNSW, n = n{=} 1,574) and 0.0001 (CIC strat)—max-prob calibration does not imply per-class calibration, so this is a property measured here, not assumed.
blocks.zh: 校准(E3):欧洲经委会的所有方法都保留在UNSW-NB15上为0.065克,但在时间上为0.39-0.45克(表1)。 政策层面的含义是准确的: " 通知/门反馈经过校正 " (Noul是门头校正损失的供应商的名字;我们称之为"门",第3节)是对训练分配的主张;它在新颖的攻击压力出现时无声地下降,而这正是要求被买下的时刻。 第5.5节显示,该效果是添加剂,存在于(而不是独立于)类砖选择之上。 选择(val)的分级校正在所有四个主跑中都保持 \leq 0.007, 而用于 g 的分级校正坐标是 0.003 (UNSW, n = n{=} 1 574) 和 0.0001 ( CIC strat) 的分级校正并不意味着每个分级校正, 所以这是在这里测量的属性, 不是假设的 。

blocks.en: 5.2. E2 — Unknown-attack honesty
blocks.zh: 5.2. E2-不明攻击诚实

blocks.en: Leave-one-family-out (LOAO): train without family F F , test against F F ’s held-out rows. Table 2 reports unseen-family detection (gate AUROC / FPR@95 without any retraining), attribution honesty (how much the choice head attributes to unknown ), and a control (macro-F1 on known families, which must not collapse).
blocks.zh: 离家出走(LOAO):无家庭F型列车,测试FF型被扣行. 表2报告隐形家庭检测(进入AUROC/FPR@95而不进行任何再培训),归属诚实(选择头部属性多为未知),以及控制(已知家庭的宏观-F1,不得崩溃)。

blocks.en: Table 2. LOAO—unseen-family detection (gate) and attribution honesty (choice abstention). The control—macro-F1 on known families—stays at 0.38–0.56 across folds, i.e., the family that is excluded does not degrade attribution of the others. UNSW Small.

blocks.en: UNSW: the gate generalizes. Nine of nine never-seen families are detected with gate AUROC ≥ \geq 0.85, most above 0.95, while macro-F1 on known families is preserved (0.38–0.56). The abstention rate on the excluded family ramps 3–92%—feature-dependent, not tune-dependent, which is exactly the honesty modulation we want (an unseen-but-gatelike family still realizes unknown 28–92% of the time instead of being absorbed into normal ).
blocks.zh: UNSW:大门一般化. 在9个从未见过的家庭中,有9个用AUROC \ geq 0.85号门检测出,大多数在0.95以上,而已知家庭的宏观-F1号则保留了下来(0.38-0.56)。 被排除在外的家庭坡道上的弃权率是3-92分(feature-dependent),而不是曲调依赖,这正是我们希望的诚实调制(一个不为人知但成熟的家庭仍然意识到28-92%的时间是未知的 ) 。

blocks.en: CIC: the failures are structural, not accidental. On stratified CIC-Small LOAO (Table 3 ), the gate remains strong where families are textually distinctive ( bruteforce 0.967, webattack 0.979, exploitation 0.970, dos_ddos 0.852), but drops below chance on recon (0.426) and near chance on infiltration (0.533, n = 5 n=5 ): in 77 flow-statistics features, port scans from a datacenter look exactly like a benign port-touching client.
blocks.zh: CIC:失败是结构性的,不是偶然的. 在分级的CIC-Small LOAO(表3)中,如果家庭具有文字特征(野蛮力量0.967、网络攻击0.979、剥削0.970、 dos_dos 0.852),但是在侦察(0.426)和渗透(0.533,n = 5 n = 5)时,入口仍然很坚固:在77个流量统计特征中,从数据中心进行的端口扫描看起来完全像一个良性港口触摸客户。

blocks.en: Scope: what a single-flow triage cannot see. This blindness is structural, and stating its boundary is part of the contribution: VX-One classifies isolated events (one flow’s statistics, one binary’s features). Reconnaissance is by definition a temporal-aggregation phenomenon—low-and-slow scans are invisible to per-event statistics and become detectable only in detection-by-behavior over time windows (event provenance, targets-per-time histograms, scanning divisibility). The perimeter architecture therefore does not rely on the per-event head for recon: Phase 1 (Suricata portscan signatures, which partially cover it) and any windowed detector sit in front of, or beside, the per-event gate (Section 5.4 ); when Phase 1 is payload-blind, the residual recon coverage is declared honestly rather than inflated.
blocks.zh: 范围:单流分流无法看到的东西. 这种失明是结构性的,说明其界限是贡献的一部分: VX-One将孤立事件分类(一个流统计,一个二进制特征). 根据定义,侦察是一种时间-综合现象——低和慢扫描对于每件事件的统计数字是看不见的,只有在随时间窗口逐一探测时才能发现(事件出处、目标-时直方图、扫描分辨性)。 因此,周边建筑不依靠每个事件头进行侦察: 第一阶段(Suricata portcan signments,部分覆盖它)和任何窗外探测器都坐落在每个活动的大门前或旁边(第5.4节);当第一阶段是有效载荷盲时,剩余侦察覆盖被诚实地宣布而不是夸大。

blocks.en: The abstention threshold measured at the default is non-portable : on UNSW, τ abs = 0.5 \tau_{\mathrm{abs}}=0.5 abstains 3–92% on excluded families; on CIC, where calibration is saturated (Table 1 , ECE ≤ \leq 0.001), the same fixed threshold abstains on zero rows—every excluded-family event gets assigned to normal with high confidence. Under-saturated models are correctly selective, over-saturated ones are confidently wrong.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下测得的弃权门槛是非便携式的:在UNSW,\ abs = 0.5\tau mathrm{abs {0.5}对被排除在外的家庭弃权3-92%;在CIC, 校准是饱和的(表1,ECE \leq 0.001),同样的固定阈值在零行上弃权——每个被排除在外的家庭活动都被高度信任地分配到正常状态。 饱和度不足的模型是正确的选择性的,饱和度过高的模型是自信地错误的.

blocks.en: Sweep: a portable threshold does not exist (Figure 1 ). We swept τ abs ∈ { 0.05..0.99 } \tau_{\mathrm{abs}}\in\{0.05..0.99\} over the LOAO logits already computed (no retraining). On UNSW the sweep admits operating points: τ = 0.5 \tau{=}0.5 abstains on 37.5 % 37.5\% of excluded-family rows with 55.0 % 55.0\% false attribution to a known attack class, and rising to τ = 0.99 \tau{=}0.99 yields 97.3 % 97.3\% abstention at 0.66 % 0.66\% false attribution—a monotone honesty/utility frontier an operator can pick from. On CIC there is no operating point: even at τ = 0.99 \tau{=}0.99 abstention reaches only 17.8 % 17.8\% of excluded-family rows; the dominant failure mode is benign absorption ( 94.5 % 94.5\% of unseen-family events attributed to normal at saturated confidence), not scattering across attack classes ( 5.5 % 5.5\% , the UNSW failure mode). Median max-probability on excluded rows is ≥ \geq 0.999 on five of seven CIC folds ( recon : 1.000 1.000 ), and the margin alternative ( p ( 1 ) − p ( 2 ) p_{(1)}-p_{(2)} , median 1.000 1.000 on recon ) inherits the saturation: margin-based selective classification ( Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ) fails for the same reason fixed thresholds do—post-hoc policies operate on the confidence distribution, and saturation has destroyed the information the policy needs. Rescuing a confidently-wrong model requires recalibration on in-scope data (per-window, online), not a sharper threshold; this is why abstention is a mitigation with preconditions , not a guarantee.

blocks.en: EMBER2024 drift: trained-unknown as an honesty mechanism. The EMBER run trains on weeks 0–45 and validates/tests on later weeks; family composition drifts measurably at test time. Gate-robustness is high (AUROC 0.997, FPR@95 0.012). The family-conditional table is the interesting one: berbew , which grew 34.5K → \to 92K rows in test, retains recall 0.998; wacatac , which mutated, falls to recall 0.129 with 85% → \to unknown ; grandoreiro ( n = 226 n=226 , almost absent from train) falls to 0.221 with 78% → \to unknown. The model does not reduce drift into false attribution; the unknown option absorbs what the model should not claim to know, and the gate keeps the operator’s safety threshold honest on the detection side simultaneously. This is the strongest single argument for the trained-unknown semantics (and contrasts directly with Table 3 on two ways of switching unknown on/off in Section 5.5 ).
blocks.zh: EMBER2024漂流:训练有素-不为人所熟知的诚实机制. EMBER运行于0–45周的列车,并在后周进行验证/测试;在测试时,家庭构成可以估量地漂移. 门-硬度很高(AUROC 0.997,FPR@950.012)。 家庭条件表是有趣的:Berbew在测试中成长了34.5K ~\到92K行,保留了召回0.998;wacatac,变异了,召回0.129,85% ~\去不明;grandoreiro (n=226n=226,几乎不在火车上)降为0.221,78%~\去不明. 该模型不会减少漂移到虚假的归属;未知选项吸收了该模型不应声称知道的东西,而闸门同时使操作员的安全阈值在检测方面保持了诚实. 这是训练有素的不为人知的语义学最强的单一论据(并且与表3直接对比的是第5.5节中两种未知的开关方式).

blocks.en: The two unknown mechanisms carry the same typed meaning but are not the same estimator. On EMBER2024, unknown is a trained class with real ground truth (benign and tail malware), so its probability is an in-distribution rejection statement. Under LOAO on UNSW/CIC, the excluded family is not a candidate: abstention runs on max-softmax confidence over the seen families, which is out-of-distribution similarity detection ( Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2017 ) —the classic max-softmax baseline, with its known overconfidence failure modes—not a calibrated probability about the excluded family. We therefore report unseen-family detection (gate) and abstention separately and never describe the latter as a probability of the unseen event. Both mechanisms lose informative honesty modes measurably (Tables 2 – 3 ); the design lesson is that distribution shift has no single calibrated fix—the honest object is the pair (gate, abstention), not one number.
blocks.zh: 两种未知的机制带有相同的打字意义,但并不是相同的估计. 在EMBER2024上,未知是一门训练有素的有真地真人(benign和尾端恶意软件)的班级,因此其概率是分配内拒绝声明. 根据UNSW/CIC的LOAO,被排除在外的家庭不是候选家庭:弃权者对所见家庭最大软度的信心运行在外分配相似度检测上(Hendrycks和Gimpel, 2017年),这是典型的最大软度基线,其已知的过度自信失败模式并不是对被排除在外的家庭的概率进行校正。 因此,我们报告未见家属的发现(门)并单独弃权,绝不将后者描述为未见事件的概率。 两种机制都以可衡量的方式失去信息诚实模式(表2-表3);设计教训是,分配转变没有单一的校正固定——诚实的对象是一对(门,弃权),而不是一对.

Measurements use single-events, batch=1, single-thread CPU, 3,000 timed events per model, on each model’s exact released weights (Table 4 ).

blocks.zh: 表 4. E4 耐用性(单项活性,批量=1,一线,CPU). 在一个 < 10 ms 设计预算, 差值为 5 ×\克 5\时。

blocks.en: Interpretation: VX-One’s typed decisions carry a p50 inference cost of ∼ \sim 1 ms on Small, making VX-One a per-event inline decision component rather than a sampled-batch tool. The commercial System One class’s headline latency claims are API-level; level-by-level comparison is not apples-to-apples, and we treat them as context, not as competition.
blocks.zh: 口译: VX-One的打出的决定带有p50的推论成本为\\ sim 1 ms on Small, 使得VX-One成为每起事件内置决策组件,而不是被取样的批量工具. 商业系统一等头条空档要求是API级;逐级比较不是苹果对苹果,我们把它们当作上下文,而不是竞争。

blocks.en: 5.4. E5 — Two-phase cascade: how much of the line of fire is actually a gray zone
blocks.zh: 5.4. E5 — 二相级联:火线到底有多少是灰色地带

blocks.en: We reconstruct five days of CIC-IDS2017 into PCAPs (documented reconstruction, no payload— attacks’ HTTP bodies are not recovered, so content-only signature rules are expected to underperform and this is the lower bound they encounter on this traffic in the deployed position), run Suricata 7.0.10 with fresh Emerging-Threats Open rules (52,674 of them, concatenated) plus 8 of our own structural rules to level the playing field for header-only signals, then measure per family which attacks Phase 1 catches and what lands in the gray zone for Phase 2 to handle. Table 5 collates per day.
blocks.zh: 我们把5天的CIC-IDS2017重建成PCAP(有记录的重建,没有有效载荷-攻击) HTTP机构没有恢复,因此只内容的签名规则预期会表现不佳,这是他们在部署位置的流量上遇到的下限,运行Suricata 7.0.10 使用新的"新兴-危险"开放规则(其中52,674个,收缩了)加上我们自己的结构规则中的8 来平整只头信号的竞技场地,然后测量每个攻击的家庭 第1阶段 捕捉和什么土地 在灰色地带 第二阶段处理。 表5每日核对。

blocks.en: Table 5. E5 cascade over five days of CIC-IDS2017. “F1 acc” is Phase 1 (Suricata) alone; “comb” is the estimated combined cascade; P/R = precision/recall of the combined cascade on that day’s test rows. Stats are estimates with a documented independence assumption (Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: 表5. 2017年CIC-IDS5天的E5级级联。 " F1 cc " 仅指第1阶段(Suricata); " comb " 是估计的合并级联;P/R = 当日试验行合并级联的精确度/召回率。 数据是附有独立假设文件的估计数(第6节)。

blocks.en: The headline number is the gray zone under payload opacity, not a universal estimate . Suricata with ET rules over flow-reconstructed traffic detects only ∼ \sim 0.1% of daily attacks by volume; the gray zone is 99.9% of each day in this reconstruction , and Phase 2 is what actually classifies it: the combined cascade retains recall ≥ \geq 0.978 while precision stays ≥ \geq 0.95 on every day except Thursday. We are explicit about what this experiment does and does not measure. It measures the Phase-2 recoverable share when Phase 1 is payload-blind —the operational regime operators of encrypted traffic (TLS everywhere, no payload inspection in managed switches) know well—and not the real-world gray zone of a deployment with full payload visibility, where Phase 1 resolves strictly more. Second, the cascaded numbers combine Phase 1 and Phase 2 events under a documented independence assumption at the shared-flow level; signature-triggered attacks also perturb flow statistics, so true overlap is nonzero and our combined recall is an estimate anchored at the payload-blind lower bound (Section 6 ). The Thursday failure is the real lesson : on a web-attack day of 456K benign and only 2.2K attacks, Phase 1 is structurally blind without payload (precision 0.059), Phase 2 absorbs all of it, and the FP rate of Phase 2 across 456K benign rows dominates the combined precision (0.552). A cascade is not free: every false flag from the blind-detection phase is multiplied by the innocent traffic around it; the correct operating posture there is Phase 2 as advisory (block with abstention, not auto-drop). This measurement—a live-tier engine’s gray-zone share on a public benchmark under payload-only reconstruction—is, we believe, the crudest and most defensible novel number in this paper.
blocks.zh: 标题编号是有效载荷不透明下的灰色区域,而不是一个通用的估计. Suricata对流量调节的交通规则只按流量检测出 \ sim 0.1%的每日攻击; 灰地区在此次重建中为每天99.9%, 第二阶段才是实际分类: 组合级联保留了 \ \ geq 0. 978, 而精确度则保留 \ \ \ eq 0.95, 每天除星期四外。 我们清楚地知道这个实验能做什么,不能衡量。 它测量第1阶段是有效载荷盲时的Phase-2可回收份额——加密通信的操作系统操作员(到处都是TLS,没有在管理下的开关中有效载荷检查)非常清楚——而不是部署具有充分有效载荷能见度的现实世界灰色地带,而第1阶段更能解决。 第二,级联数字将第一阶段和第二阶段的事件合并在一起,根据共享流量的有记录的独立假设;签名触发攻击也扰动了流量统计,所以真正的重叠是非零的,而我们的综合召回则是以有效载荷-盲下接线为基础的估计(第6节)。 星期四的失败是真正的教训:在456K良性攻击的网络攻击日,只有2.2K的攻击,第一阶段在结构上是盲的,没有有效载荷(精度0.059),第二阶段吸收了全部,而跨456K良性行的第二阶段的FP率支配了综合精度(0.552)。 级联不是免费的:从盲测相中产生的每个假旗被周围的无害交通相乘;正确的操作姿态是第二阶段作为咨询(以弃权来挡住,而不是自动投放). 这种测量 -- -- 在仅有效载荷重建的公共基准上的一个活地发动机的灰色区份额 -- -- 我们认为,这是本文中最粗糙和最可靠的新数字。

blocks.en: Risk–coverage of the cascade’s own gating (measured). We additionally measured the adjudication quality of the composed policy as a per-day risk–coverage curve (adjudicate “attack” iff Phase 1 flagged the flow or the Phase-2 gate exceeded τ \tau ; abstain otherwise; risk = 1 − - precision of the adjudicated set; Phase-1 leg exact per flow, Phase-2 leg exact per test row, composed leg under the documented independence assumption of Table 5 ). Findings: (i) the benign-only Monday is a null point — every adjudication is an error, so no operating point exists at risk ≤ \leq 30%; (ii) on the Friday wave (DDoS+PortScan, 41% of flows) the composed policy admits 0.416 of flows at risk ≤ \leq 5%, the whole plateau supplied by Phase 2 (Phase 1 adjudicates 0.0004 of flows at precision 0.067: under payload opacity it contributes latency and provenance, not adjudication coverage, Δ ≤ \Delta\leq 1 point); (iii) the small-attack Thursday (0.5%) is where the cascade costs its own gate: Phase 1’s 0.11% flag rate at precision 0.059 corrupts every composed operating point, so nothing is admissible at risk ≤ \leq 10%, and Phase 2’s clean core covers only 0.44% (min risk 0.3%). This closes the next step of Section 7 .

blocks.en: Text branch (a1). On UNSW the protocol/service/state lookups are worth ∼ \sim 5 macro-F1 points and nontrivial AUROC. UNSW’s original feature set is partly categorical field values (proto, service, state), so the text branch supplies exactly the vocabulary a numeric encoder cannot infer. On EMBER2024 the ablation is an identity by construction: the 2,568 input features are already structural PE statistics (histograms, byte-entropy, imports), and no text field exists to ablate—which is also why the EMBER runs drop the lookup tables from the input projection entirely.

This is the expected signature of a well-behaved calibration layer, and worth saying plainly because calibration is our semantic differentiator.

On saturated CIC, removing the tilt ω \omega improves attribution by + 4.9 +4.9 macro-F1—the de-tilt pushes minority classes down in a regime where the weighted cross-entropy had already pushed them up. On weakly-distributed EMBER the tilt matters less. There is no free class-tilt knob; its effect is deployment-regime-dependent, and our own loss design contains a knob whose default is wrong for saturated datasets. We say so and flag the design revision.

blocks.en: 5.6. E7 — The commercial System One baseline, measured
blocks.zh: 5.6. E7 -- -- 商业系统一号基线

blocks.en: We ran the zero-shot API comparison this cycle against a commercial System One deployment that exposes the same primitive names publicly (single decision model, documented gate/choice/score questions; one API request per flow containing the three primitives over the identical frozen feature state we feed our heads). The sample is the protocol-fixed stratified draw (seed 42) of the UNSW test set: 1,000 benign and 1,021 attack flows, attack quota proportional to family with a floor of 15. The vendor numbers are in Table 7 ; the gate is at chance on this distribution (AUROC 0.568, FPR@TPR95 0.932), choice attribution is equally degenerate (macro-F1 0.069 over our frozen candidate set vs our 0.534), and severity MAE is almost 3 × 3\times ours. Vendor latency: 208 ms p50 / 591 ms p95; total run cost ≈ \approx 2.2M input tokens (US$0.09 at the vendor’s published rate). An ablation adding an explicit unknown option to the vendor’s choice question—re-run over the full 2,021-row sample so the comparison is paired (identical rows; the only difference is the extra option)—leaves the picture unchanged and slightly degrades it: gate AUROC 0.476 (from 0.568 without the option), macro-F1 0.066 (from 0.069), and the vendor assigns unknown to only 0.35% of rows (0.2% of attacks, 0.5% of benign). The escape hatch is available and unused: the gap is caused neither by the absence of an abstention option nor by prompt sensitivity, but domain adaptation—the generic triad zero-shot does not transfer to network-flow distributions. The paper’s positioning therefore still does not lean on beating a commercial model; E7 closes the follow-up by measuring it, and is reported as an external stress test rather than a contribution.

blocks.en: 5.7. Discussion
Three threads bind the results together.
blocks.zh: 三线将结果捆绑在一起.

blocks.en: (1) The honest triage division of labor. Where the benchmark is saturable (stratified CIC), trees win attribution and a typed cascade adds nothing but a latency reduction; where the deployment regime is adversarial (temporal drift, attack families that did not exist in training), the gate/unknown semantics earn their keep in detection robustness and attribution honesty even while losing the calibration war (E3). The contribution is the measured boundary of where typed decisions help, not a uniform “we win everywhere”.
blocks.zh: (1)诚实分工. 如果基准是饱和的(最低的CIC),树木赢得归属,而打入的级联只会增加暂时性减少;如果部署制度是对抗性的(时空漂移,攻击训练中不存在的家庭),大门/未知的语义学家即使输了校正战争(E3),也会在检测稳健性和归属诚实性方面获得保留. 贡献是衡量打字决定有助于什么的界限,而不是统一的“我们在任何地方获胜”。

blocks.en: (2) Honesty is a distinct axis from accuracy. Section 5.2 and the EMBER drift table are the clearest pair of the paper: a benchmark-optimal system (no unknown option, accurate operating threshold) maximizes macro-F1 while falsely attributing 85% of a mutated family; the honesty-first system gives up 11 macro-F1 points on the choice metric and absorbs the mutation into an honest abstention. These are different products under drift, and the macro-F1 column alone cannot distinguish them.
blocks.zh: (2) 诚实是不同于准确性的轴心。 第5.2节和EMBER漂移表是论文中最清楚的一对:一个基准-优化系统(没有未知选项,准确的操作阈值)将宏-F1最大化,而错误地将一个突变的家族的85%归属;诚实-第一系统在选择度量上放弃了11个宏-F1分,将突变吸收为诚实的弃权. 这些是漂移下的不同产品,单是宏-F1柱无法区分.

blocks.en: (3) Saturation is a deployment regime, not a benchmark property. The same dataset (CIDS2017) produces a saturated benchmark under stratified splitting and a hard unsaturated one under by-day splitting, in both ranking and calibration. Any paper reporting “F1 0.94” on IDS2017-stratified is measuring the model’s ability to fit a monotone flow of re-used capture artifacts; papers should report the by-day numbers alongside (we do both).
blocks.zh: (3)饱和是部署制度,不是基准财产. 同一数据集(CIDS2017)在分层分解下生成饱和基准,在分层分解后生成硬不饱和基准,在分层分解后的分层分解中,在分层分解和校正中均生成. 任何报告 " F1 0.94 " 2017年ISS级的论文,都是衡量模型装入被重新使用的捕获文物的单通流的能力;文件应该同时报告日间数字(我们都是这样做的)。

blocks.en: 6. Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: • Severity scores are rubric-derived , not human-labeled; the Score head’s ground truth is a documented family → \to level mapping, so cross-level claims are approximations above benign/low/high/critical. • Benchmark data, audited (Section 4 ): LOAO measures generalization across benchmark families , not robustness against real-world novel attacks; an honest reading of E2 is “the gate generalizes more than the choice head, on these families”—not “we detect zero-days”. • Single-seed runs outside the four main tables. The four main-table runs (UNSW Small, CIC strat-Small, CIC by-day, EMBER temporal) were re-run with seeds { 42 , 43 , 44 } \{42,43,44\} : the seed-42 reruns reproduce the official numbers to the fourth decimal (reproducibility confirmed), ranking metrics move ≤ \leq 0.02 points, and multi-class macro-F1 on CIC carries a real spread ( 0.83 ± 0.07 0.83\pm 0.07 stratified; 0.34 ± 0.09 0.34\pm 0.09 by-day—drift instability, not implementation nondeterminism). The rest of the tables (per-family LOAO, ablations, E4 latency, E5 cascade) remain single-seed runs; conclusions that rest on differences > > 5 points are robust to this, but the small head-to-head diffs on CIC strat (cf. a2/a4 in Section 5.5 ) should be read as noise-borderline. • Phase 1 is a reference implementation (Suricata + ET Open + 8 structural rules), not our C++ engine; the claims of Section 5.4 are about the architecture , and the reconstruction means payload-content rules are at a lower bound by construction. The “combined cascade” result is a documented two-sample estimate under an independence assumption that is exact for full-family-invisibility cases and optimistic where Phase 1 fails on exactly the stealthiest subset; we state it as an estimate, and the per-day F1/gray-zone table it rests on is a real measurement. • Calibration under drift (ECE 0.40 on temporal CIC) is measured and now also audited by a walk-forward per-window recalibration experiment (E8, Appendix A ): with one-day-delayed labels, gate recalibration (temperature or 2-parameter Platt) recovers part of the loss (Brier 0.539 → \to 0.504 on the hard day), but the oracle bound shows the ceiling is discrimination, not calibration —even fitting the calibration on the day’s own labels leaves gate ECE at 0.445 with day-AUROC 0.56. Per-window recalibration is therefore a cheap partial fix. Its prescribed alternative is also measured (E9, Appendix A ): one to two passes of per-window continue-training with delayed day-1 labels recover day-2 gate AUROC to 0.80–0.84 (four passes regress to 0.76) and, with the recovered ranking, the recalibration ceiling collapses from ECE 0.445 to 0.10–0.12—but as-run day-2 ECE stays at 0.554 and no delayed-label fit recovers the new day’s composition prior, which lands on the abstention/coverage semantics of Section 5.2 rather than on any post-hoc map. • Conformal wrappers are scoped, not promised, and now audited. Exact distribution-free coverage applies only under exchangeability: on the official UNSW split and stratified CIC, split-conformal coverage is exact ( Papadopoulos et al., 2002 ; Tibshirani et al., 2019 ) ; on every temporal split, family-composition drift is real and measured, and coverage degrades at a rate bounded by the calibration–test total-variation gap ( Barber et al., 2023 ) . A domain classifier certifies that gap only from below ( d TV ≥ 1 − 2 ​ BER d_{\mathrm{TV}}\geq 1-2\,\mathrm{BER} ; Appendix A )—we therefore report empirical weekly coverage with exact binomial intervals and weighted variants ( Tibshirani et al., 2019 ) , and make no distribution-free coverage promise; the measured EMBER audit is in Appendix A (binary set-coverage within [ 0.895 , 0.935 ] [0.895,0.935] across all twelve test weeks; certified drift d TV ≥ 0.15 d_{\mathrm{TV}}\geq 0.15 – 0.24 0.24 ). • Cost-per-million is not yet measured from real billing data; latency, not cost, is the number we claim. • Text-field attack surface (indirect prompt injection through user_agent , URIs) is real ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) ; V0.1 has no sanitization layer and our text-branch vocabulary lookup (bounded 135-slot vocabularies, not free max-k) is only partial mitigation. • Vendor-API baseline is a single-point stress test (Section 5.6 ); we measured one commercial System One deployment zero-shot on one distribution (dense UNSW flows), not an exhaustive comparison across commercial decision models, prompt variants, or distributions. The honest reading is “the generic triad zero-shot does not transfer to this domain without fine-tuning”, not “the vendor cannot be fine-tuned to this domain”.

blocks.en: Single-seed runs outside the four main tables. The four main-table runs (UNSW Small, CIC strat-Small, CIC by-day, EMBER temporal) were re-run with seeds { 42 , 43 , 44 } \{42,43,44\} : the seed-42 reruns reproduce the official numbers to the fourth decimal (reproducibility confirmed), ranking metrics move ≤ \leq 0.02 points, and multi-class macro-F1 on CIC carries a real spread ( 0.83 ± 0.07 0.83\pm 0.07 stratified; 0.34 ± 0.09 0.34\pm 0.09 by-day—drift instability, not implementation nondeterminism). The rest of the tables (per-family LOAO, ablations, E4 latency, E5 cascade) remain single-seed runs; conclusions that rest on differences > > 5 points are robust to this, but the small head-to-head diffs on CIC strat (cf. a2/a4 in Section 5.5 ) should be read as noise-borderline.

blocks.en: Phase 1 is a reference implementation (Suricata + ET Open + 8 structural rules), not our C++ engine; the claims of Section 5.4 are about the architecture , and the reconstruction means payload-content rules are at a lower bound by construction. The “combined cascade” result is a documented two-sample estimate under an independence assumption that is exact for full-family-invisibility cases and optimistic where Phase 1 fails on exactly the stealthiest subset; we state it as an estimate, and the per-day F1/gray-zone table it rests on is a real measurement.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段是参考执行(Suricata + ET Open + 8 结构规则),而不是我们的 C++ 引擎;第 5.4 节的主张是关于建筑的. 重建意味着有效载荷-内容规则在建筑的下限. “合并级联”的结果是在独立假设下记录的两次抽样估计,这种假设对于全家不见的情况是准确的,对于第一阶段在最隐秘的子集上失败的情况是乐观的;我们把它说成是一种估计,它所依赖的每天F1/gray-zone表是一个真正的衡量。

blocks.en: Calibration under drift (ECE 0.40 on temporal CIC) is measured and now also audited by a walk-forward per-window recalibration experiment (E8, Appendix A ): with one-day-delayed labels, gate recalibration (temperature or 2-parameter Platt) recovers part of the loss (Brier 0.539 → \to 0.504 on the hard day), but the oracle bound shows the ceiling is discrimination, not calibration —even fitting the calibration on the day’s own labels leaves gate ECE at 0.445 with day-AUROC 0.56. Per-window recalibration is therefore a cheap partial fix. Its prescribed alternative is also measured (E9, Appendix A ): one to two passes of per-window continue-training with delayed day-1 labels recover day-2 gate AUROC to 0.80–0.84 (four passes regress to 0.76) and, with the recovered ranking, the recalibration ceiling collapses from ECE 0.445 to 0.10–0.12—but as-run day-2 ECE stays at 0.554 and no delayed-label fit recovers the new day’s composition prior, which lands on the abstention/coverage semantics of Section 5.2 rather than on any post-hoc map.
blocks.zh: 漂移下校正(ECE 0.40 on Time CIC)是测量的,现在也通过走道向前的每道窗口校正实验(E8,附录A)进行校正:加有一日延后标签,门重校正(温度或2参数平板)可收回部分损失(硬日为Brier 0.539 ~\ 0.504),但甲骨文约束显示天花板是歧视,不是校正——甚至符合当天自有标签的校正标准 ECE 0.445与日为AUROC 0.56。 因此,每个窗口的再校正是一种廉价的部分固定. 其规定的替代办法也是衡量的(E9,附录A):每窗继续训练的一至二个通行证,但延迟的日-一标签恢复了日-二门AUROC为0.80-0.84 (四个通行证递回到0.76),随着恢复的排名,重新调整的天花板从欧洲经委会的0.445倒数到0.10-0.12,但运行的日-二的欧洲经委会仍停留在0.554,没有延迟的标签适合恢复新日的构成,因为新的日-一标记落在第5.2节的弃权/遮盖语义上,而不是任何后图上。

blocks.en: Conformal wrappers are scoped, not promised, and now audited. Exact distribution-free coverage applies only under exchangeability: on the official UNSW split and stratified CIC, split-conformal coverage is exact ( Papadopoulos et al., 2002 ; Tibshirani et al., 2019 ) ; on every temporal split, family-composition drift is real and measured, and coverage degrades at a rate bounded by the calibration–test total-variation gap ( Barber et al., 2023 ) . A domain classifier certifies that gap only from below ( d TV ≥ 1 − 2 ​ BER d_{\mathrm{TV}}\geq 1-2\,\mathrm{BER} ; Appendix A )—we therefore report empirical weekly coverage with exact binomial intervals and weighted variants ( Tibshirani et al., 2019 ) , and make no distribution-free coverage promise; the measured EMBER audit is in Appendix A (binary set-coverage within [ 0.895 , 0.935 ] [0.895,0.935] across all twelve test weeks; certified drift d TV ≥ 0.15 d_{\mathrm{TV}}\geq 0.15 – 0.24 0.24 ).
blocks.zh: 正式的包装是范围大,没有承诺,现在已审计。 精确的无分布覆盖只在可交换性下适用:在正式的UNSW拆分和分级的CIC上,有精确的分分布形式覆盖(帕帕佐普洛斯等,2002年;蒂比希拉尼等,2019年;在每次时间拆分上,家庭组合漂移是真实的并经过测量的,覆盖率以校准测试总变量差距为限度(Barber等,2023年)。 域分类员只证明以下(d TV 1 - 2 BER d_{\mathrm{TV}}\geq 1-2\,\matmathrm{BER};附录A)存在这一差距——因此,我们每周报告具有精确的二元间隔和加权变体的经验性报道(Tibshirani等,2019年),并且没有保证无分配;计量的EMBER审计载于附录A(在所有12个测试周内在[0.895,0.935] [0.895,0.935] [0.895,0.935]之内的二元套封;经认证的活性d TV 0.15 d_{\mathrm{TV}}\geq 0.15-0.24 0.24]。

blocks.en: Vendor-API baseline is a single-point stress test (Section 5.6 ); we measured one commercial System One deployment zero-shot on one distribution (dense UNSW flows), not an exhaustive comparison across commercial decision models, prompt variants, or distributions. The honest reading is “the generic triad zero-shot does not transfer to this domain without fine-tuning”, not “the vendor cannot be fine-tuned to this domain”.
blocks.zh: 供应商-API基线是单点压力测试(第5.6节);我们测量了一个商业系统一号部署在一次分配(密集的UNSW流量)上,而不是对商业决策模型、即时变体或分配进行详尽的比较。 诚实的解读是,“一般的三相零镜头不进行微调,不会转移到这个领域”,而不是“供应商不能被微调到这个领域”。

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en: We built, trained, calibrated, and stress-tested a typed decision engine for perimeter triage—the first published instantiation and public-data evaluation of the System One primitive triad—and report the boundary of its advantage rather than a uniform win: detection robustness and attribution honesty under unknown families and drift, a measurable gray zone of a live signature engine, and four cleanly-measured negative results (calibration collapse under drift, non-portable abstention thresholds, regime-dependent class tilts, unknown-option accuracy cost). Six former next steps are already measured: the vendor-API comparison (Section 5.6 — the commercial primitive triad zero-shot sits at gate-chance on network flows, and an explicit abstention option is not enough to close the domain gap), the abstention-threshold sweep (Section 5.2 , Figure 1 —on saturated deployments no abstention threshold recovers honesty, so selective behavior must be bought with data and recalibration, not with post-processing), the 3-seed re-runs of the four main tables (seed-variance ≤ \leq 0.02 points on ranking metrics; Section 6 ) and the walk-forward per-window recalibration under drift (E8, Appendix A —a cheap partial fix whose oracle bound shows the hard-day ceiling is discrimination, not calibration), its prescribed alternative, per-window re-training (E9, Appendix A —one to two passes with delayed day-1 labels recover day-2 gate AUROC 0.56 → \to 0.84 and re-enable oracle recalibration, while four passes regress and as-run ECE is unmoved: weight freshness buys discrimination, not calibration), and the risk–coverage curves of the cascade’s own gating (Section 5.4 —on payload-blind traffic the coverage at fixed risk is supplied entirely by Phase 2, the benign-only day is a null point where no operating point exists, and the small-attack day is where Phase-1 false flags cost the gate itself). The remaining next step is a payload-inclusive Phase-1 measurement to replace the lower-bound cascade estimate. All code, configs, tests, and measured results accompany the paper.
blocks.zh: 我们建造、训练、校正和压力测试了用于周边分解的打入式决策引擎——第一次公布的对系统一个原始三合一的即时和公开数据评价——并报告其优势的界限,而不是统一的赢法:在未知的家庭和漂移下检测稳健性和归属诚实性,一个活的签名引擎的可测量灰色区,以及四个经过清洁测量的负结果(在漂移、非便携式弃权阈值下校正倒塌,依赖制度的等级倾斜,未知的精确性成本)。 已经测量了6个先前的下一步:供应商-API比较(第5.6节 -- -- 商业原始三相零射点在网络流量上靠门-跳出;第6节 -- -- 明确弃权选项不足以缩小域间差距),弃权断层扫描(第5.2节,图1 -- -- 在饱和部署上不弃权阈值恢复诚实,因此必须用数据和重新调整来购买选择性行为,而不是在处理后进行),四个主台的3个种子再运行(种子-变量-==leq 0.02 分数;第6节)和在漂移下走前行走入入入入入入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 接下来的一步是采用包含有效载荷的第一阶段测量,以取代下限级联估计。 所有代码、配置、测试和测量结果都随论文而来。

Across the twelve test weeks: unweighted coverage 0.895 0.895 – 0.935 0.935 (exact binomial intervals), benign-side ≥ \geq 0.905 everywhere, malicious-side down to 0.884 0.884 (week 60) — the loss concentrates on the positive class. Per-week feature drift is certified from below: d TV ≥ 0.15 d_{\mathrm{TV}}\geq 0.15 – 0.24 0.24 (held-out BER; domain-classifier AUC 0.61–0.64, so the feature-space drift is real but modest). The weighted variant (clipped odds [ 0.1 , 10 ] [0.1,10] , Tibshirani-style quantile) moves coverage by ≤ 0.022 \leq 0.022 with no consistent direction — with estimated weights it is mitigation, not guarantee, and here it is unnecessary: what drifts over the four months is the family mixture (label shift, absorbed by unknown ; Section 5.2 ), not the benign/malicious feature distribution. blocks.en: On the CIC by-day run (test in capture order: Friday-DDoS n = 138 n{=}138 k, then Friday-PortScan n = 286 n{=}286 k), we re-fit the gate’s calibration on the previous window only (day 1 falls back to the static val; day 2 uses day-1 labels, the honest delayed-labels regime), either as a temperature (1 parameter) or as a 2-parameter Platt map p = σ ⁡ ( a ​ logit + b ) p{=}\sigma(a\,\mathrm{logit}{+}b) , and re-derive the FPR@TPR95 threshold from the same window’s positives. On the DDoS day (AUROC 0.99) the oracle bound recovers almost all calibration error (ECE 0.127 → \to 0.029, gate fitted on the day’s own labels); on PortScan (AUROC 0.56) the same post-hoc moves are marginal: ECE 0.553 (static) → \to 0.526 (Platt with one day of fresh labels), and even the oracle bound — calibrating on the test labels of the day itself — leaves gate ECE at 0.445 (Brier 0.539 → \to 0.246: the oracle predicts a constant near the day’s prior). Measured verdict: per-window recalibration is a cheap partial fix whose ceiling under strong concept shift is the head’s discrimination, which no post-hoc map can repair ; the choice head’s confidence, in contrast, is fully recalibratable (choice ECE 0.543 → \to 0.056 at oracle, macro-F1 unchanged by construction).

blocks.en: The follow-up E8 leaves open— re-training instead of recalibration—is measured identically: continuing to train the deployed CIC artifact on its training split plus the full day-1 window with delayed labels ( n = + 138 n{=}{+}138 k; frozen feature stage, candidate set, and class weights; one pass at a reduced learning rate, streaming-honest). On the PortScan day the gate recovers ranking: AUROC 0.560 → \to 0.800 with one pass, 0.839 at the two-pass sweet spot, and a measured regression to 0.760 at four passes (over-fitting to the fresh window). Confidence, however, does not follow: as-run day-2 ECE is unchanged (0.553 static vs. 0.554 retrained), and a Platt map fitted on the delayed day-1 labels cannot express the new day’s composition—it fits a near-null shift ( b ≈ − 0.3 b\approx-0.3 to − 0.7 -0.7 ) on the now-saturated day-1 scores where the day-2 oracle shift is b ≈ + 8 b\approx{+}8 – 13 13 . What the recovered ranking buys is an expressive calibration ceiling: the same oracle bound that capped static calibration at ECE 0.445 collapses to 0.117 (one pass) and 0.100 (two passes) on the retrained scores, i.e., the static ceiling was limited by ranking, not by the mechanism. Choice macro-F1 on day 2 is unchanged (0.102). Measured verdict: weight freshness buys discrimination, not calibration —scheduled re-training with a fresh-window validate step is a real (if schedule-sensitive) countermeasure to drift, while the composition prior of a genuinely new day remains inferable from no post-hoc statistics and de-facto demands the abstention/coverage semantics of Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 后续的E8离开——重新培训而不是重新校正——是同样测量的:继续训练部署的CIC文物在训练分拆上加上全日一窗口并有延迟标签(n = + 138 n{=}{+}138 k;被冻结的特征阶段,候选人设定,以及课重;一次通过降低学习率,流畅诚实)。 在"PortScan"一日,大门恢复了排名:AUROC 0.560 ~\至0.800,通过一通,在"双通"甜点上为0.839;在"四通"(与"新鲜"窗口相匹配),经过测量的回归为0.760. 但是,信任并不随之而来:运行中的第2天欧洲经委会没有变化(0.553个静态对0.554个再训练),在延迟的第1天标签上安装的普拉特地图不能表示新一天的构成——它符合现在饱和的第1天或第2天或第3天的分数(b-0.3 b-约0.3 至 0.7)的近乎零分的分数,即第2天或第3天的分数为b-+8 b-约==-8 13分。 恢复的排名买入的是一个表达式校正上限:在ECE 0.445倒塌时将静态校正上限限制在0.117(一次通过)和再训练分数上0.100(两次通过)的同一种甲骨文约束,即静态上限受排名限制,而非机制限制. 第2天的选择宏-F1不变(0.102). 衡量的判断:重量新鲜度可以接受歧视,而不是校正——以新窗口验证步骤安排的再训练是真正(如果对时间表有敏感认识的话)的对漂移的反措施,而真正新的一天之前的构成仍然不能从任何事后统计中推断出来,事实上要求第5.2节的弃权/遮盖语义。
